channel.title: Best Little Sites - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Best Little Sites (comicbookmovie.com)

item.title: Has MAN OF TOMORROW Been Given A New Title? Lars Eidinger Comments On Being Cast As Brainiac
item.description: Lars Eidinger has weighed in for the first time on joining the cast of James Gunn's Man of Tomorrow as Brainiac. We also have word on a possible title change...

item.title: X-MEN May Begin Filming Sooner Than Expected; LOKI And THE FANTASTIC FOUR Production Designer Joins Reboot
item.description: Marvel Studios' X-Men reboot may begin filming sooner than expected, and the movie has also found a production designer in The Fantastic Four: First Steps' Kasra Farahani.

item.title: New Details On THE FANTASTIC FOUR's Scrapped Steve Rogers Scene (And What It Means For AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY)
item.description: More details about Chris Evans' scrapped cameo in The Fantastic Four: First Steps have been revealed, and we have some insights into what it means for Avengers: Doomsday.

item.title: James Gunn Debunks MAN OF TOMORROW Title Change Rumor; Addresses DCU Batman, PARADISE LOST Rumors
item.description: DC Studios co-CEO James Gunn has weighed in on several recent rumours, including Man of Tomorrow's supposed title change, plans for the DCU's Batman, and claims Paradise Lost is shelved.

item.title: JAY & SILENT BOB: JAYS OF FUTURE PAST Is The Marvel Comics Crossover You Never Expected To See
item.description: Marvel Comics has announced perhaps its most unexpected crossover yet, as Jay & Silent Bob: Jays of Future Past will see Kevin Smith combine Jay & Silent Bob with the Marvel Universe!

item.title: MCU Rumor Roundup: Thanos' Return; Possible SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Leak, And More
item.description: In this roundup, we have updates on the first trailer for Spider-Man: Brand New Day, Josh Brolin's return as the Mad Titan, and more...

item.title: HBO's HARRY POTTER TV Series Has Cast A Second Ron Weasley For Season 1
item.description: Three more actors have joined Harry Potter Season 1, revealing a better idea of what to expect from the HBO series (as a second, slightly older Ron Weasley boards the cast).

item.title: VENOM Animated Movie Officially Moving Forward From FINAL DESTINATION Directors; Tom Hardy Involved
item.description: The Lethal Protector is returning to theaters, and he may end up bringing Tom Hardy with him, because an animated Venom movie is officially moving forward at Sony Pictures.

item.title: ROGUE ONE: A STAR WARS STORY Returns This Summer With New Anniversary Comics From Marvel
item.description: Marvel Comics has announced plans to revisit 2016's Rogue One: A Star Wars Story this summer, with 10th anniversary one-shots revolving around Cassian Andor, Jyn Erso, Darth Vader, and more.

item.title: M.A.S.K. Joins The Energon Universe - New Comic Book From Robert Kirkman's Skybound Announced
item.description: M.A.S.K., the '80s animated series and Kenner toy line, is getting a revival courtesy of a new comic book from Robert Kirkman's Skybound Media banner...
